Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1328
Claimant:
Caleb Johns
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
06/30/2024
First notice of loss received for a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The insured reports that the vehicle
was stopped at a red light when it was struck from behind.
07/07/2024
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force on the date of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates coverage.
08/15/2024
Police report obtained. Responding officer confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene and records the
collision as described by both drivers.
08/22/2024
Statements taken from two independent witnesses. Both describe the impact the same way as the insured and say
the other vehicle was moving too fast to stop.
10/03/2024
Scene and vehicle photographs reviewed. The rear damage is largely consitsent with the impact described, and no
prior damage to the vehicle is known from the records available.
10/09/2024
Other driver interviewed and does not dispute the sequence of events or the point of impact.
10/15/2024
Claimant is represented by counsel. Initial medical report lists a wrist fracture, which is a typical injury for this type
and force of impact, and there is no known prior injury to that area.
10/31/2024
Claimant's account was revisited in a recorded follow-up. Some small details were added, but the core sequence of
events has stayed the same across every statement.
11/05/2024
Treatment records reviewed. Care followed a usual course, with activity restrictions and therapy easing as the
claimant's condition improved.
11/27/2024
Medical file shows steady recovery and a tapering off of treatment visits. Counsel has been copied on all updates
requested for the bodily injury evaluation.
11/28/2024
File reviewed and assessed as consistent across the police report, witness statements, photographs, vehicle damage
and medical records. Claim moving to bodily injury evaluation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
